digest.component_or_area: CLI core dispatch and execution routing
propositions: Top-level CLI execution must dispatch through a single validated lazy route selected from the registry, resolving exactly one handler per command via a closed adapter kind set without second-parse or signature introspection.

Registry route metadata (init policy, mount eligibility, handler, adapter, legacy output) must be the sole authority for execution shape and selection, replacing parallel policy frozensets and explicit intercept ladders.
Only the selected handler and parser modules must be imported during dispatch; unrelated optional-capability stacks, reconcilers, and handler factories remain unimported.
Registry-derived mount/init behavior, confirmation, global output extraction, legacy JSON shapes, and token preservation after `--` must match pre-cutover behavioral tests exactly.
Bridge compatibility spellings and hidden commands (bridge-status via approved adapter; purge-bridge unknown) must route through approved adapters with no deviation from existing execution contracts.
Rollback capability must be preserved via derived compatibility exports with zero delta, allowing reversal to pre-dispatch state without handler, help, or persisted-data changes.
